name: softball-scorer
description: This program assists with the tracking of stats for softball teams.

scripts.start:dev: concurrently --kill-others -n srv,client,css "yarn start:server" "yarn start:client" "cd client && yarn watch:css"
scripts.start:prod: node scripts/kill-ports.js 8888 && cd server && yarn start:prod
scripts.test: (cd client && yarn test) && (cd server && yarn test)
scripts.test:ci: (cd client && yarn test:ci) && (cd server && yarn test:ci)
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules shared-lib/node_modules build/ client/coverage server/coverage
scripts.lint:fix: (cd client && yarn lint:fix) && (cd server && yarn lint:fix) && (cd shared-lib && yarn lint:fix)
scripts.lint:check: (cd client && yarn lint:check) && (cd server && yarn lint:check) && (cd shared-lib && yarn lint:check)

author: Browns and Co.
